facts.fact: Circular of the Head of Government no. 04 of 2026 lists among its references decree-law no. 31 of 10 June 2020 on electronic data exchange between structures and their users and between structures, as approved by law no. 14 of 7 April 2021; the date of the fact is the approving law, and the circular is of 28 August 2026.
